name: Real Issues Example
description: Template for creating scenarios from real problematic LLM responses. Copy your problematic responses from logs here.

responses.description: Replace this with description of the problem you're testing

arguments._comment: REPLACE THIS ENTIRE 'arguments' OBJECT WITH YOUR REAL PROBLEMATIC RESPONSE
arguments.title: Paste your real problematic title here
arguments.content: Paste your real problematic content here with all the formatting issues
arguments.example_field: Add any other fields that were in your real response

responses.description: You can add multiple problematic responses to test different issues

arguments._comment: This is another example - replace with your real response
arguments.left_content: Real problematic left content from your logs
arguments.right_content: Real problematic right content from your logs
arguments.title: Real problematic title

how_to_use: 1. Copy this file to a new file with a descriptive name (e.g., 'my-formatting-bug.json')
2. Replace the 'name' and 'description' fields with your own
3. For each response, replace the 'arguments' object with the real problematic response from your logs
4. Update the 'id' and 'description' fields to describe each specific issue
5. Adjust the 'trigger' to match when you want this response to be used
6. Save the file and use: node scripts/test-scenarios.js set your-scenario-name

trigger_types.function_name: Triggers when a specific function is called (e.g., 'generate_slide_text')
trigger_types.prompt_contains: Triggers when the prompt contains specific text (e.g., 'two-columns')
trigger_types.template_id: Triggers when the prompt mentions a specific template ID

finding_logs: Look in your browser console or server logs for LLM responses
Search for 'function_call' or 'arguments' in the logs
Copy the entire response object that caused formatting issues
